name: Healing
description: Restores lost hit points, either a flat amount or a value that scales by spell slot/character level.

mechanics.text: On use, restores hit points. An item's own healing is usually one fixed value (featureParams.healingDice); a spell's own healing usually scales instead — featureParams.scaling carries the full ladder, one dice entry per spell slot/character level. This Feature's own tier below doesn't replace or duplicate that: the tier is a budget-relevant power classification (roughly, how strong a healing source this record represents overall — costed lower than feat.damage's equivalent tier, matching this ruleset's own existing asymmetry that healing is priced below damage at the same power level), scaling is the exact numbers a GM reads off at the table. A record with no tier chosen falls back to this Feature's own base budgetCost (tier-1, the cheapest). Distinct from feat.mending-pulse, whose own fixed tiers exist specifically for the Potion of Healing family's own values.
